body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-10-29 (Q2FY25 concall transcript): "as of now, there is no defined timeline. The company has taken an enabling resolution by the Board ... we will look at the opportune time and go for this fund raise" Metric: Equity/quasi-equity raise; multi-year capex. Target: ~INR 600 cr raise; ~INR 800 cr capex FY25-FY28. Deadline: enabling valid ~1 year (to ~Oct-2025). Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: The enabling resolution lapsed unused. INR 433.5 cr was raised later by preferential issue (Jul-26), about 72% of the size. Capex FY25-FY27 runs ~INR 200-300 cr a year, in line with the ~INR 800 cr/4 yrs estimate.

body: CFO (Shashank Patel to 2025; Diane McClintock from 2026) on 2025-08-07 (Q2-2025 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool)): "We now expect organic sales growth of flat to up 3%, a two-point increase to the midpoint from our previous outlook." Metric: organic sales growth FY2025 (company). Target: 0% to +3%. Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered.
